title: Your AI keeps telling you what you want to hear? try this.
description: Your AI keeps telling you what you want to hear? try this.
transcript: Have you noticed that every AI tool is a [ __ ] pushover? It like just says whatever you said to it. It doesn't argue with you, it doesn't challenge you, it doesn't push back. [music] And the crazy part is it knows when you're full of [ __ ] and yet it still agrees with you. So, here's how you fix that forever. Go into your settings and you can insert this and just tell it this line, "Be my ruthless mentor. You have to stress test everything. If my ideas are trash, tell me [music] why and get things to the point where they're bulletproof." Now the AI will tell you what [music] you need to hear not what you want to hear.
